The player uses the core C library with its own GLFW integration.
Local patch: cui_dialog_opts.center_title centers the modal title and balances
the space occupied by its standard close button. Menu items also accept a
tooltip anchored to the item itself, used for the WAV export filename.
The data grid calculates its visible row range after applying scroll input and
animation, using the same offset as rendering and the sticky header. This fixes
missing rows during fast wheel input, scrollbar dragging and cursor jumps.
Caller-supplied cursor changes center the row in the body viewport (clamped
at the list bounds); keyboard navigation retains its minimal reveal behavior.
The grid also reveals the initial caller-supplied cursor and snaps its content
and sticky header to the same pixel boundary. Its scroll viewport is inset by
its border width: outward pixel rounding of fractional clip coordinates must
not expose row text above the frame, including at fractional display scales.
Sliders accept a press and release received in the same frame, as generated by
quick touchpad taps, without requiring the mouse button to remain held.
Data-grid scrollbars remain visible whenever their content overflows, including
while idle, to show the current position and the extent of the list. Their
vertical track and hit area exclude the fixed header; thumb size and dragging
use the body viewport and body content heights.
Text options accept a passive tooltip, used for song metadata on title hover.
Tooltip text uses context-owned growable state instead of a fixed 256-byte
buffer so complete metadata is retained and released with the context.
Data grids optionally treat column widths as relative weights and recompute
them from the viewport on resize. The player uses 25/50/15/10 for its columns.
Other upstream sources are unchanged.

Only build inputs and license notices are included; upstream demos, tests,
documentation images and web tooling are omitted.
